label: Test by Controls for the typed LORD_3 reading, checked for Whatever is LORD_2 is LORD_1
note: Tests the converse strength implication in the registered interpretation. Same InAct, CausesIn, esse, Governs and IsLord. The strong version gives LORD_1 to every cause and governor of all; the weak one only to such a being that also wills some good of their own to every other intellectual being. Control part 2: a cause and governor of all that wills no good to an existing intellectual creature satisfies the weak version and falsifies the strong one.
